start.title: Black Thursday
start.text: Mission briefing: Schweinfurt, the ball-bearing works, deep in Germany. The Thunderbolts can only take you as far as the border; after that you are on your own. Fly with the stream, or against it.
start.hint: <kbd>1</kbd>–<kbd>4</kbd> pick a role · <kbd>←</kbd> <kbd>→</kbd> move · <kbd>Enter</kbd> take it

status.detail: The fighters are coming up in strength
